stats.text:
An event in your past left an indelible mark on you, infusing you with simmering magic. As a {ref:glossary/bonus-action}, you can unleash that magic for 1 minute, during which you gain the following benefits:

- The spell save DC of your Sorcerer spells increases by 1.
- You have {ref:glossary/advantage} on the attack rolls of Sorcerer spells you cast.

You can use this feature twice, and you regain all expended uses of it when you finish a {ref:glossary/long-rest}.
